desc:
Sounds of shots taken from side-by-side shooter during a Pheasant shoot. Recorded with RODE NTG-1 shotgun on SONY FS7, audio pulled directly from .mxf file and rendered into 48kHz WAV files. 

This sound is part of a pack, and series of other sounds that I will be uploading. Feel free to use in your projects, no credit required. Thanks :)
title: Two close range shots.wav
author: moosegravy
